title: Genome Browser
bodyHtml:
Genome Browser

Explore this interactive single cell chromatin accessibility genome browser of human pancreatic islets. Tracks are derived from single-nucleus ATAC-seq (snATAC-seq) data from 41 human donors sourced from HPAP.

Usage

Start by selecting the cell type(s) and track type(s) to be visualized. Click the gray box to search by gene name, SNP ID, or genomic region (GRCh38 human reference genome coordinates). Use the tools at the top to drag or reorder tracks, zoom in/out, or pan across genomic space. Hover over each tool or visualized ATAC-seq signal for more information.

View within UCSC genome browser

The same data has also been loaded within the UCSC Genome Browser, where you may co-analyze with external track data related to genes, variants, phenotypes, literature, RNA, regulation, etc.

Download Data

Download the underlying dataset used to generate this genome browser or view our snATAC-seq data processing standards. Learn about the underlying donors, samples, and input files here.

Learn more

Learn more about PanKbase donor data, donor metadata, and data and metadata standards. Find quantitative trait loci (QTLs) of the queried gene through PanKgraph.

Citation requirements

If you use data from this page, please review our Citation Policies to ensure proper citation of the underlying resource(s) used to generate these maps.
